alignments.note: Substantival article takes the pronoun the ASV supplies to make the participle a clause subject, under rule 41.
Participle rendered as a finite English verb.
The ASV promotes the preposition's object to the bare direct object of *healeth*, leaving the `לְ` no English word; `unrepresented` under rule 40.
Anarthrous substantival participle with the supplied *the* under rule 46, headed on the word carrying the lexeme.
Nomen rectum: the ASV recasts the construct relation with *in*, which belongs to the rectum under rule 19.
Participle rendered as a finite verb; *up* is the phrasal particle of *bind up* and stays with it under rule 44.
The recasting leaves this `לְ` with no English word, its object standing as the bare object of *bindeth up*; `unrepresented` under rule 40.
Pronominal suffix as possessive under rule 18.
The margin's literal gloss *sorrows* was read and set aside; the printed *wounds* governs, by rule 38.
